name: workout-tracker
description: A mobile-first, self-hosted workout plan, session, and training archive tracker for Cloudflare Workers and D1.

scripts.test:contracts: node --test tests/boundaries.test.js tests/plan-update-structure.test.js tests/training-archive-safety.test.js tests/public-repo-readiness.test.js tests/public-source-gate.test.js
scripts.test:coverage:persistence: node --experimental-test-coverage --test-coverage-include=src/store.js --test-coverage-lines=90 --test-coverage-branches=70 --test tests/d1-persistence.test.js tests/canonical-assembler.test.js tests/canonical-rebuild.test.js tests/canonical-plan.test.js tests/canonical-session.test.js tests/migrations.test.js
scripts.test:coverage:validation: node --experimental-test-coverage --test-coverage-include=src/validation.js --test-coverage-lines=95 --test-coverage-branches=55 --test tests/core.test.js tests/agent-plan-update.test.js tests/agent-plan-apply.test.js tests/plan-update-batch.test.js tests/plan-update-structure.test.js tests/canonical-plan.test.js tests/canonical-results.test.js tests/training-archive-safety.test.js
scripts.test:coverage: npm run test:coverage:persistence && npm run test:coverage:validation
scripts.mcp:check: node --check mcp/bridge.mjs && node --check mcp/cli.mjs && node --check mcp/launch.mjs
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.core.json --pretty false && tsc -p tsconfig.interfaces.json --pretty false && npm run typecheck:web
scripts.source:acceptance: npm run seed:verify && npm run forbidden-scan && npm run assets:check && npm run licenses:check && npm run source:scan && node scripts/release-acceptance.mjs
scripts.public:gate: npm run typecheck && npm run build && npm run test:behavior && npm run test:integration && npm run test:contracts && npm run test:interfaces && npm run test:ui && npm run test:browser && npm run test:coverage && npm run docs:lint && npm run source:acceptance
scripts.public:gate:online: npm run public:gate && npm run audit:runtime && npm run audit:development
